crossRefs.note: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord Yahweh.
“I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a…
O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not…
Men will call them rejected silver, because Yahweh has rejected them.”
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into God’s…
Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies. They weary…

people.name: Cush
people.line: Ancient region in Africa; associated with Egypt and Babylon

translations.web: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.
translations.bsb: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Neither are you able to do good— you who are accustomed to doing evil.
translations.kjv: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
translations.asv: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
